queries: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS count_relative_to_average, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM city_counts ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, city_id LIMIT 10

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count - AVG(address_count) OVER () AS count_difference_from_average, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM city_counts ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, city_id LIMIT 10

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS city_count, SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses FROM city_counts) SELECT c.city_id, c.address_count, c.address_count * t.city_count / t.total_addresses AS relative_to_average, c.address_count / t.total_addresses AS share_of_all_addresses FROM city_counts c CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, c.city_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: “Relative to the average” means the city’s address count divided by the average count among cities appearing in the address table.

alternatives.interpretation: If “relative to the average” means the difference from that average, subtract the average instead.
